title: Naruto: I Can Extract Abilities
author: Cheng Chang De Xiang Jiao
description:
Uchiha Shuichi awakens under the shadow of the impending massacre of his clan. At the age of five, he awakens memories of his past life and a right hand capable of plundering all things.

He can take abilities, physical constitution, spirit, and even conceptual life and bloodline from living beings or corpses.

Using plunder as a blade, he will forge a path never before seen in the ninja world. Mangekyou Sharingan, Wood Release, Sage Body—all these powers will be at his disposal.

Let's set a small goal first: to become the strongest ninja in the world.
